card.name: Gentle mixing steps and clause breaks
card.fires_on: The word "to" after a gentle mixing action on a vial or bag (roll, tilt, invert), meaning "in order to". It also fires on commas or "and" right after a named reaction such as serotonin syndrome or anaphylaxis.

modes.label: Purpose "to" after mixing
modes.description: "To" follows a gentle roll, tilt or invert instruction and introduces the purpose, such as dissolving or mixing.

modes.description: A comma or "and" comes right after a named adverse reaction, before a description or the word symptoms.
